caption_L1: This area chart is labeled Average London fix price of silver from 1975 to 2019 (in U.S. dollars per ounce). The x-axis plots Year on linear scale from 1980 to 2010 while the y-axis shows Price in U.S. dollars per ounce on linear scale from 0 to 40.
caption_L2L3: There was a peak in the price of silver at $20 per ounce in the 1980s. It then dropped to $5 per ounce until the mid-2000s. It then rose until the price peaked at $35 in 2010. It then dropped again to around $17 per ounce.
